zh.title: 達美航空計畫9月起以空中巴士A330-900neo執飛紐約至特拉維夫航線
zh.summary: 達美航空9月6日起恢復紐約至特拉維夫每日服務，採用空中巴士A330-900neo。
body: 根據媒體 Simple Flying 報導，達美航空（Delta Air Lines）計畫於2026年9月正式恢復前往以色列特拉維夫的客運航班。該航線預計採用空中巴士 A330-900neo 廣體客機進行營運。
根據報導細節，這項航班服務預計將自9月6日起開辦，屆時達美航空將提供由紐約起飛往返特拉維夫的每日定期直飛航班服務。
依據本站歷史紀錄，達美航空在其新款空中巴士 A330-900neo 客機上配置了 56 套 Delta One 套房座位，採用高比例高階艙等配置，主要鎖定重點跨大西洋航線需求。

en.title: Delta Air Lines To Resume New York-Tel Aviv Flights With Airbus A330-900neo In September
en.summary: Delta Air Lines will resume daily flights from New York to Tel Aviv starting September 6.
body: Delta Air Lines is preparing to resume passenger flights to Tel Aviv with service starting in September 2026. The airline plans to operate the route using Airbus A330-900neo aircraft, according to reporting by Simple Flying.
Daily services from New York to Tel Aviv are scheduled to commence on September 6. The return of these daily flights restores direct air connectivity for the carrier between New York and Tel Aviv.

According to verified historical records, Delta's new Airbus A330-900neo fleet features a premium-heavy interior layout including 56 Delta One suites aimed at the carrier's top transatlantic passenger routes.
